lines.text: Many learners say: I live here since two years.
Better: I have lived here for two years.
Use for with a length of time.
For! I have worked here for three years.

data.wrong: I live here since two years.
data.right: I have lived here for two years.
data.why: Use for with a length of time.

quiz.stem: I have worked here ___ three years.

native.tip: Für eine Zeitdauer wie „zwei Jahre“ nimmst du „for“ und die Zeitform „have lived“.
native.caption: Sagst du auch “I live here since two years”? 🙈 Im Englischen heißt es “I have lived here for two years”. Hör Carlos zu und sprich nach! Mehr üben in der Lexkite-App.
native.comment: Lösung: “for”. Für eine Zeitdauer nimmst du „for“, für einen Startpunkt „since“. Übe mehr mit einem kostenlosen Quiz: {link}

en.tip: For a length of time like “two years” you use “for” and the tense “have lived”.
en.caption: Do you also say “I live here since two years”? In English it is “I have lived here for two years”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
